injuries.longComment: Irving is close to a full ACL surgery recovery, so he should be a full participant by the time training camp comes around in the fall. The star guard hasn't yet gotten the chance to take the floor since the Mavericks drafted Cooper Flagg last year, so it'll be interesting to see how the two mesh once they're sharing the backcourt duties together.
injuries.shortComment: Irving (knee) should be fully healthy by the end of the offseason, per Christian Clark of The New York Times.
